PHD IN MECHANICAL ENGINEERING ADMISSSIONS REQUIREMENTS

The Prince Mohammad Bin Fahd University’s (PMU) PhD in Mechanical Engineering is designed for professionals interested in developing and acquiring knowledge beyond their initial degree in order to improve their career prospects. The PhD in Mechanical Engineering is a qualification designed to widen the horizons of engineer professionals. The PhD program provides employees with the skills and competencies, which make them eligible for promotion into leadership positions. Examples of the opportunities available to the graduates are Oil and Gas, Petro Chemical, Manufacturing, Product Design, HVAC Engineering, Power Generation, Piping System, Industrial Management and Education Leadership.
A completed baccalaureate and master degree in Mechanical Engineering* from a recognized university
A minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 out of 4.00 or equivalent (Very Good) in Bachelor’s & Master’s Degree
*Applicants with closely related disciplines to Mechanical Engineering can apply upon conditions specified by the College of Engineering.

A valid IELTS certificate (Academic version) with minimum scores of 6.0 overall and 5.5 in each skill or equivalent TOEFL iBT minimum scores of 83 overall and 19 in each skill (online or home edition is not accepted)

Statement of purpose: A statement of purpose (usually around 500 words) in which the applicant summarizes his/her professional goals, including professional objectives, research interests, his/her motivation for graduate work and other significant information.

Letters of reference: Applicants must submit at least two letters of recommendation that attest to their professional competence, academic preparation, and potential for graduate work. The two letters should clearly reflect professional success and foresee academic success at the graduate level. Ideally, one letter should be from a college or university professor who can discuss the applicant’s academic abilities and one should be from an administrator or colleague who can authoritatively describe the applicant’s professional experience and potential.
Work experience: Successful candidates are preferred to have industrial experience.
Candidates will be personally interviewed by committee of the program administrators and faculty

Admissions to the Executive Master in Business Administration (EMBA) Program

The Executive Master in Business Administration (EMBA) is a 33 credit-hour graduate program designed to be completed in two years, with participants attending courses on weekends while maintaining their full-time employment status. Admission into the EMBA does not require an undergraduate business degree or the completion of business foundation courses; instead, the curriculum is designed for working professionals from a variety of educational backgrounds. The program intends to empower participants to become impactful business leaders; as such, instead of delivering in-depth knowledge in a single specific functional business area, the courses provide a broad management overview that allows participants to develop a comprehensive understanding of all business fields. Participants are required to have several years of work experience after their undergraduate degrees and will complete the program as a cohort.
A Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized university
A minimum GPA of 2.50 out of 4.00 or equivalent (Very Good) in Bachelor’s Degree
Successful candidates should have from three to five years of professional work experience

A valid IELTS certificate (Academic version) with minimum scores of 6.0 overall and 5.5 in each skill or equivalent TOEFL iBT minimum scores of 83 overall and 19 in each skill (online or home edition is not accepted)
A letter from their employing organization stating its agreement with the student’s participation in the program and allowing time from work, as necessary, to participate in the program
Three reference letters from supervisors and others in superior positions within the employing organization or others who can provide appropriate references

Each candidate who otherwise meets the selection criteria will be personally interviewed by a committee of program administrators and faculty. The interview will provide an opportunity to see the candidate in a setting of personal interaction and thus can help to determine whether or not the candidate has the right skill set for the program.

Admissions to the Master of Business Administration (MBA) program

The Master of Business Administration (MBA) is a 36 credit-hour evening program that can be pursued on a full-time or part-time basis, thus allowing participants full flexibility when integrating graduate studies into their demanding personal and professional lives. After fulfilling common MBA core requirements, participants can choose from six different concentrations: General Management, International Finance, Project Management, Entrepreneurship and Innovation, Supply Chain Management, and Marketing. Admission into the MBA does not require an undergraduate business degree, but non-business majors may be given the opportunity to take four business foundation courses before beginning their MBA coursework which can then be completed in as few as two years. The program intends to empower participants to successfully launch their own enterprises or to excel in middle and upper management positions at companies of all sizes and in all industries.

Admissions to the Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering (MSME) Program

The Saudi industry demands for deep technical expertise in mechanical engineering will continue to grow steadily and rapidly for many years to come. The Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering (MSME) at PMU is aligned with the Saudi Vision 2030 by producing highly skilled mechanical engineers who will take part in enriching the national economy by fulfilling critical high tech market needs and by creating economic opportunities for the Saudi entrepreneur, the small and medium Saudi enterprises, as well as the Saudi large corporations. The MSME program is available with thesis and non-thesis options. Each option requires a minimum of 30 credit hours, including 12 credit hours of required courses, which can be completed in two years. The MSME is offered in Two tracks: Thermofluids track and Mechanical Systems track.

Admissions to the Master of Arts (MA) in International Business Law Program

Prince Mohammad Bin Fahd University’s College of Law (PMU Law) is the premier institution of legal studies in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia. The year 2025 marks another milestone for PMU Law with the approval of the postgraduate program Master of Arts (MA) in International Business Law (the Program) by the Ministry of Education, Saudi Arabia. Developed by a body of legal experts, the program provides a specialized study of law that will equip the candidates for the national, regional, and global business environment.
